prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 3:4 cinematic vintage-film portrait of an adult Asian woman in a dim 1990s-inspired wood-paneled bedroom. She has long voluminous wavy black hair, natural dewy skin, soft glossy rose lips, and a thoughtful upward gaze. She wears a cream long-sleeve buttoned blouse with a modest neckline, high-waisted dusty-pink wide-leg trousers, and black ankle boots. Pose her sitting comfortably on a patterned rug with legs folded to one side, one hand resting on a vinyl sleeve and the other near a red rotary phone. Surround her with vinyl records, bed linens, abstract poster shapes, and magazines with no readable pages. Use warm low indoor lighting, deep gentle shadows, film grain, a 50mm shallow-depth look, and no text, logos, or watermark.
